title: AI video makers

criteria.name: Output quality

anchors.0: No page publishes max export resolution and max video length for any paid plan
anchors.3: Pricing or docs page states max export resolution (1080p or higher) and max video length for at least one named paid plan
anchors.5: Everything in 3, and the pricing or docs page states 4K export on a named plan or a single-video length of 10 minutes or more on a named plan, and lists supported export formats or aspect ratios

criteria.where: Pricing page plan table; product docs or help center "export" article

criteria.name: Price and value

anchors.0: No price published for any paid plan (contact sales only)
anchors.3: A paid plan's price is published with its billing period and the limit it buys (minutes, credits or videos per month)
anchors.5: Everything in 3, and the price per published minute of video on the lowest paid monthly plan is the lowest in the ranked set, or within 10% of the lowest. Credit-based plans only count if a page states how many credits one minute costs; otherwise the tool scores 3

criteria.where: Pricing page; credits explainer in help center

criteria.name: Ease of use

anchors.0: No page describes the onboarding or editor
anchors.3: A help article or product page describes an editor and a template library (the template gallery is public)
anchors.5: Everything in 3, and a help article describes a prompt-to-video or script-to-video flow that produces an exportable video without a manual editing step

criteria.where: Product page; help center "getting started" and "create a video" articles

criteria.name: Free tier

anchors.0: No free plan and no free trial published
anchors.3: A free plan or free trial is published, with a watermark on exports or tight caps on length or credits
anchors.5: A free plan is published and its page or terms say exports have no watermark

criteria.where: Pricing page; plan comparison table; terms of service

criteria.name: Fit for the use case

anchors.0: The pages document 0 or 1 of the 4 fit features below
anchors.3: The pages document 2 or 3 of the 4 fit features
anchors.5: The pages document all 4 fit features, and the product page or docs name small business, local business or ad creation as an intended use

criteria.where: Product page; features page; terms of service (commercial use clause)

criteria.name: Update pace

anchors.0: No dated product or changelog entry in the 12 months before the check date
anchors.3: A dated entry in the 6 months before the check date
anchors.5: At least 2 dated entries in the 90 days before the check date

criteria.where: Changelog, release notes, product blog with dates, help center "what's new"

fit_features: Upload your own video or photos
Terms that allow commercial use on the plan we point to
